verdict.rationale: Docs show building blocks—step-by-step execution for long-running tool calls (docs-9), step callbacks to alter agent memory (docs-8), and memory replay (docs-7/16/20)—that could be composed into a human-in-the-loop pause/resume flow, but there is no explicit documented feature for pausing mid-run to request human approval and resuming with that decision. Missing for 10: a first-party 'human approval' or 'interrupt/resume' API, docs/tutorial demonstrating pause-for-input, and any hands-on confirmation this workflow works as intended.
